again.speaker: scout
again.text: DEMO: Back again?! Good, good, ask me stuff!

first.speaker: scout
first.text: DEMO: HEY! You made it! The terminal over there keeps making noises, I barked at it!

ask.speaker: scout
ask.text: DEMO: So what do you wanna know?

choices.text: That recording the terminal printed was something.

ship.speaker: scout
ship.text: DEMO: Wrong turn near Mars. A VERY wrong turn. The pilot swears it was a heater switch.

terminal.speaker: scout
terminal.text: DEMO: It hums. I barked. It hummed back. Try it, press the thing!

archive.speaker: scout
archive.text: DEMO: Right?! Everything you find goes in the archive. Hit Tab. I left a note in there.
